warnings.message: This stack is conditional. Resolve the listed data and integration checks before production.
Validate failover and end-to-end latency in the selected region. The stack and planning band do not guarantee either target.

assumptions: Regulated workloads are limited to evaluation with synthetic data and sandbox payments until service eligibility, processor agreements, and data paths are verified. Production approval is pending.

existing_systems_plan.guidance: If used for enterprise sign-in, verify that the provider is allowed inside the deployment boundary, then broker it through Keycloak over OIDC or SAML. Test role mapping and deprovisioning.
Check version, ownership, schema and residency. If approved, keep it as the system of record behind a read-only adapter initially. Reconcile exported records before any migration or cutover.
Inventory supported interfaces, ownership and deployment constraints. Keep the existing system behind an approved API or adapter where possible, and migrate one workflow at a time if reuse is unsafe.

capacity_plan.request_rate_basis: Estimated from 300 concurrent users at one request per user every 20 seconds.
capacity_plan.database_storage_basis: 20 GB floor, 30% headroom, and 20% of stored data allocated to database records.
